title: PRISM/AI — T: Trust
description: Guardrails, bias assessments, red-team findings, alignment controls, and explainability requirements governing AI trustworthiness.

trust.description: Trust artifacts declaring how AI model and system behavior is constrained, evaluated, and kept within intended boundaries.

id.description: Unique identifier for this trust artifact.

type.description: What kind of trust artifact this is.

trust_type.description: The dimension of trustworthiness this artifact addresses.

enforcement.description: How this trust control is enforced when triggered.

remediation_status.description: Current status of remediation or compliance with this control.

depends_on.description: IDs of the model or system artifacts this trust control applies to.

severity.description: Severity level — required for red_team_finding; recommended for all others.

threshold.description: The condition or threshold that triggers this control (e.g., 'accuracy < 87%', 'demographic disparity > 5%').

review_cadence.description: How often this control is reviewed or re-evaluated (e.g., 'quarterly', 'per-release').

evidence.description: Link or reference to supporting evidence (test report, audit finding, eval run ID).
